noncomputable def VTask.prev (α : Type*) [DecidableEq α] (l : List α) (x : α) (h : x ∈ l) : α := 
  let index := l.indexOf x
  let len := l.length
  let prev_index := (index + len - 1) % len
  l.getD (by sorry) prev_index
